summary: Draft an About Us, tone of voice guide, and audience profile in one pass.

useCases.title: Build a brand identity document
useCases.message: Help me build a brand identity document. Ask me about the company, product, and the audience I am trying to reach. You might want to look at any existing content or website before drafting. Then write an About Us, a tone of voice summary, and an audience profile I can use across campaigns and onboarding.
